_howToUpdate: This file controls the optional YouTube video in the 'About Sihina KDU' section of the page.
While the "videos" list below is empty ([]), the video area is completely hidden.
TO ADD A VIDEO: put an entry inside the square brackets of "videos", for example:
"videos": [
"url": "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID",
"title": "SIHINA 2026 – Project launch",
"description": "One or two sentences about the video (optional).",
"uploadDate": "2026-10-06"
FIELDS:
url          (required) Any normal YouTube link works: youtube.com/watch?v=…, youtu.be/…,
youtube.com/shorts/…, youtube.com/live/…, youtube.com/embed/…, or just the 11-character video ID.
title        (recommended) Shown under the player and used for accessibility and Google.
description  (optional) Shown under the title.
uploadDate   (optional, YYYY-MM-DD) The date the video was published on YouTube. When it is given,
the video is also described to Google so it can appear in video search results.
MORE THAN ONE VIDEO: add more { … } entries separated by commas. The first one is shown in the player;
the others appear as small thumbnails under it that visitors can click to switch videos.
TO HIDE THE VIDEO AREA AGAIN: make the list empty:  "videos": []
RULES: keep the double quotes, put a comma between entries but not after the last one, and check the file
at https://jsonlint.com if the video does not appear. A broken file simply hides the video area.
The video must be Public or Unlisted on YouTube, with embedding allowed (YouTube Studio → video → Details → Show more → Allow embedding).
